Class RankingDAO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.database.RankingDAO
public class RankingDAO extends Object
Data Access Object for player credentials and match ranking data.

Provides methods to authenticate players, retrieve and update rankings, and record match results in the database. All methods open and close their own Connection via DBManager.connect().

  • Method Details

    • requestLastId

      public static int requestLastId()
      Retrieves the ID of the last recorded game from the database.

      Returns 0 if the database is unreachable or the table is empty.

      Returns:
      the last game ID, or 0 if it cannot be retrieved

    • reportPlayerPlace

      public static int reportPlayerPlace(String nickname, int playerCount)
      Returns the global ranking position of a player for matches with the given number of players.

      The position is 1-based: a return value of 1 means the player has the highest cumulative score among all players in that category. Returns -1 if the database is unreachable.

      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's nickname
      playerCount - the number of players in the match category to consider
      Returns:
      the player's ranking position (1-based), or -1 on error

    • requestRanking

      public static Map<String,Integer> requestRanking(int playerCount)
      Retrieves the global ranking for matches with the given number of players, ordered by total score descending.

      Each entry maps a player's nickname to their cumulative score across all recorded matches in that category. Returns an empty map if the database is unreachable.

      Parameters:
      playerCount - the number of players in the match category to rank
      Returns:
      an ordered map of nickname → total score, never null

    • insertMatch

      public static void insertMatch(int gameId, String nickname, int score, int playerCount, Date date)
      Inserts a match result for a single player into the database.
      Parameters:
      gameId - unique identifier of the game
      nickname - the player's nickname
      score - the score achieved by the player in this match
      playerCount - the total number of players in the match
      date - the date on which the match was played
